name: brainstorm
title: Brainstorm
description: A fast idea-shaping pass: lock the prompt contract, do the product research, and converge on a shared understanding of the concept. No design, build, or QA phases — effort is capped for quick turnaround.

phases.title: Prompt Contract
phases.purpose: Preserve the user's original prompt before any discussion, convert it into a clear execution contract, list hard requirements, non-goals, success metrics, production-readiness expectations, and decision rules for every later phase.

phases.title: Product Research
phases.purpose: Before product debate begins, infer the likely market, audience, competitors/patterns, platform expectations, risks, and native iOS opportunities from the prompt. Label assumptions clearly and turn the research into implications for the first build.

phases.title: Initial Discussion
phases.purpose: Establish a shared, precise understanding of what this app is, who it is for, the core problem it solves, hard scope boundaries, and measurable success criteria.
